description: This file defines synchronization utilities for managing API locks, including thread-local flags, lock guards, and registration functions for API methods within a C++ project. It includes template classes and functions to handle locking mechanisms, method registration, and thread safety in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct that maintains a static recursive mutex for each class type to ensure thread-safe API locking.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: Template RAII guard that unlocks the API mutex upon construction if the thread is using the locked API, and re-locks it upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: RAII class that manages locking and unlocking of the API mutex for a specific class type.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a std::function that wraps a method call with mutex locking and exception handling, setting a thread-local flag during execution.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a method with the JSONRPC system, associating it with a specific object and method, using the locking mechanism.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a method with version support, associating it with a specific object and method.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a method with a JSONRPC handler, associating it with a specific object and method.
